title: MiniMax M3 joins the model lineup
summary:
MiniMax M3 arrived, Flux changed backends, and nine community apps joined the catalog while model routing and documentation got a tune-up.

Added `minimax-m3` with text and image input, tool use, reasoning, and a 1,048,576-token context window. It also accepts the `minimax3` and `minimax-3` aliases. The existing `gemma` model now routes through OpenRouter.

`flux` now uses Fireworks FLUX.1 schnell, passing through requested seeds and resizing results when explicit dimensions are supplied. It uses the nearest supported aspect ratio; `negative_prompt` is now supported only by `zimage`.

The app catalog added Portuguese-language chat, Vietnamese-language image and text tools, amigurumi patterns, photo tools, AI-learning chat, image generation, an anime Telegram bot, a multimodal text app, and vector mascots. The Greenhouse count reached 811 apps.

daily.text: Use `minimax-m3` for text and image input, tools, and reasoning, with a 1,048,576-token context window. [Browse MiniMax M3](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax-m3).

daily.title: Flux changes image backends
daily.text: `flux` now uses Fireworks FLUX.1 schnell. Requested seeds carry through, and explicit width and height are handled by resizing the result; use `zimage` if you need `negative_prompt`. [Browse Flux](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=flux).
